verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud ML platform, but the evidence describes Paperspace only as a hosted GPU cloud run in Paperspace datacenter regions. Nothing shows a self-hostable or on-prem distribution of the product. Root access to rented VMs and community reports of hosting other software on Paperspace boxes are adjacent capabilities and do not count as self-hosting Paperspace itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
